title: Red apple · photo
description: Detect the single red apple, including its yellow-red body. Ignore the cast shadow.
context: Independent photograph. Specular highlights and yellow skin test incomplete color masks. Report visible dimensions in pixels; there is no physical calibration.

strategies.name: Red apple hue
strategies.rationale: Red and orange skin should isolate much of the apple; inspect missing yellow regions and highlights.

strategies.name: Apple silhouette
strategies.rationale: Brightness may recover more of the body but could include its shadow.

title: Tennis ball · photo
credit: KS / Christian VisualBeo Horvat · CC BY-SA 3.0
description: Detect the large foreground yellow-green tennis ball. Ignore the partial distant ball at the upper left.
context: A textured sphere with printed lettering, pale seams and edge artifacts. The main ball nearly fills the frame. Bounding-box matching alone does not validate accurate segmentation or physical size.

strategies.name: Yellow-green ball mask
strategies.rationale: Color selects the ball surface. Large-area filtering may reject the partial background ball.

strategies.name: Ball brightness baseline
strategies.rationale: Brightness is a weak baseline because the background and ball overlap in intensity.

title: Horse silhouette · 2D
description: Detect the black horse silhouette as one object, retaining its narrow legs, ears and tail.
context: Independent binary 2D silhouette. Extra blur or morphology can erase small parts. Length/width are visible rotated bounding rectangle extents, not anatomy measurements.

strategies.name: Direct silhouette
strategies.rationale: The clean binary input needs only brightness selection; avoid destroying thin features.

strategies.name: Smoothed silhouette
strategies.rationale: Compare a heavier cleanup and check whether legs and ears are lost.
